title: Vulp's Head Owl
description: This mod adds a cute little Owl ontop of your head to accompany you in your travels
body:
This small mod adds a cute a sleepy owl onto your head to accompany you through your adventures.

**DISCLAIMER: The Owl currently only works WITHOUT shaders**

Actions of the Owl:
- Breathe
- be cozy

This mod also contains a command to change the appearance of the owl called: /owlAppearance
with (in the future) multiple owl variants
